narratives.headline: Four games, all unders: Fox Under 6.5 assists leads a thin card while Portland's two questionable tags hang over two props
narratives.briefing: It is a light night with 4 games, and every prop on the card is an under, with no pick rated above Consider. The best of it is De'Aaron Fox Under 6.5 assists at conviction 47 and Tyler Herro Under 3.5 rebounds at conviction 46; the other three are rated Pass and Mikal Bridges has already moved past his play-to at −152. The record is mixed and should be read that way: morning picks are 3-2-0 (+0.54u), final picks 2-3-0 (-1.57u), and game lines are 13-26 (-14.41u) since 2026-11-11, so the totals below are leans only. Closing lines have moved toward the morning picks 3 times and against them 2 times. This edition goes out before official injury reports are final: we are waiting on Deni Avdija and Toumani Camara for Portland, which the model will re-price on the next run, and on Jonathan Kuminga for Minnesota; a morning search turned up no new news on any player in the props.
